name: standing_lesson_tf_transplant
note: STANDING LESSON (promoted from H9 + T3): anatomy thresholds do not transplant across timeframes. Bar-count-denominated criteria (ranging_swings/ranging_bars, phase_age, confirm windows, registry ages) change meaning with bar duration; a composition validated at one TF carries its thresholds' SEMANTICS, not their numbers, to another. Any cross-TF transplant must re-derive or explicitly re-register every bar-denominated threshold — checking each against measured behavior at the target TF (T3's method: stage-funnel diagnostics per condition) before the run counts as a test of the mechanism.
